patch.summary: Change app-only fields (rating, read status, completion, age rating) without touching the file
patch.description: Absent fields stay unchanged, an explicit null rating clears the rating. The read status also sets the reading progress: finished = 100 % (locator href "" with totalProgression 1), unread = 0 % (href "", position 1, totalProgression 0; nothing is created without stored progress), reading keeps it. The progress row gets clientUpdatedAt = server time, so it wins over older positions of other devices; the returned book carries the new progress. completion: "ongoing", "completed" or null (unknown). ageRating: 0, 6, 12, 16, 18 or null; any value given here (also null = "no rating") is a manual value that survives re-indexing (ageRatingManual = true). resetAgeRating = true drops the manual value: the rating from the file (ComicInfo.xml AgeRating, EPUB schema:typicalAgeRange) applies again. A change bumps updatedAt, so GET /sync delivers it.

readStatus.description: unread|reading|finished (sets a manual status and the progress: finished 100 %, unread 0 %)

ageRating.description: Age rating 0|6|12|16|18, or null for "no rating" (both manual)

resetAgeRating.description: true = use the age rating from the file again (not together with ageRating)

parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

401.description: Current user is not logged in

tags.name: annotations
tags.description: Highlights, notes and bookmarks. The user always comes from the session, never from the request.

tags.name: convert
tags.description: Format conversion of comics (CBZ, CB7, CBT, CBR as source, EPUB as fixed layout target).

tags.name: editor
tags.description: Editor endpoints: structure, save, metadata patch, bulk tagging, rename.

tags.name: opds_settings
tags.description: Switches of the OPDS catalog: per user (enabled) and, for administrators, for the instance (allowed).

tags.name: share
tags.description: Sharing books and shelves with other users (read-only Nextcloud user shares managed by the app).

tags.name: task
tags.description: Status of asynchronous edit/convert tasks. Only the owner of a task can see it.

tags.name: archive
tags.description: Entry list (names and sizes) of a ZIP based book (EPUB, CBZ, FBZ). The reader uses it to fetch single entries through /item/{fileId} instead of downloading the whole file.

tags.name: comic
tags.description: Serves comics (CBZ, CBT, and CBR/CB7 when a tool is installed) page by page, so the browser does not have to download and unpack the whole archive. Pages are scaled down to the requested width bucket and cached in app data.

tags.name: cover
tags.description: Cover images are served by a normal controller (no OCS envelope).

tags.name: item
tags.description: Serves a raw zip entry (comic page thumbnails etc.) of a CBZ or EPUB for the editor.

tags.name: opds
tags.description: OPDS 1.2 catalog (Atom) for e-reader apps. Authentication is HTTP Basic with an app password: Nextcloud core logs the request in before the controller runs. The routes are #[PublicPage] only so that core does not redirect to the login form; every action refuses requests without a logged-in user itself (401 + WWW-Authenticate) and requests of users who did not switch the catalog on (or if the administrator disallowed it).
